gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham reads clean and modern, its round letters showing generous openings at the entry of each curve. Autour One, bold and uniformly drawn, sets the loud tone above while the body quietly does the reading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Cherokee, with its deep band of letters and a generously gapped e. Autour One earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Modern and compact, Noto Sans Devanagari keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Autour One, expressive and bold with an outline that never changes thickness, takes the headline spot while the body's open g stays quiet.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Autour One is expressive and bold, its curves and straight stems carrying equal weight. But Noto Sans Elbasan does the quieter work, with large lowercase forms and terminals that stay open.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Elymaic keeps every aperture open. Autour One handles the shouting, bold and expressive with no pressure swells, while the body handles steady reading with ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic is modern, with sturdy lowercase and far-reaching c terminals. Autour One, bold and bent like glass tubing, supplies the showpiece up top, and the body settles in underneath to carry the text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Clean curves and short ascender stems make this body face easy going, while Autour One handles the loud, unmodulated display work. Noto Sans Georgian saves its energy for the running text, where open curves do the work.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Noto Sans Glagolitic is approachable, with sturdy lowercase and open round letters. Page after page it stays comfortable, its open rounds holding up at small sizes, while Autour One brings the bold, expressive headings.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Autour One looks cut from strips of equal width, bold and expressive in every glyph. Noto Sans Grantha slips in beneath with small, nib-like bowls pressed flat that never close up, so the reading keeps moving.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi feels contemporary, its terminals cut back to leave a big gap. And Autour One, constant in stroke and free of sparkle, brings the bold, expressive voice while the body stays low-key.
